integrity: Exact stand-alone exhaustive forest enumeration, simplicial acyclic-matching DAG certificate, signed chain Lefschetz traces, and full character reconstruction. Ordinary math proof plus finite verifier; no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complete rational representation of the graph-automorphism group for the specified single finite graph. No integral module classification, generalization to all complete multipartite graphs, or absolute uniqueness claim. The homotopy wedge and nonequivariant Betti number are prior results, explicitly credited.
title: The complete octahedral symmetry character of discrete-Morse-complex homology
